standard.summary: 选择 LoHa 的数学实现。默认标准 LyCORIS LoHa；Lulynx 简化 LoHa 用于兼容旧训练和旧权重。
standard.effect: 标准实现生成生态通用的四个 Hada 因子；简化实现保留 Lulynx 历史公式和旧导出行为。
standard.whenToUse: 新训练使用标准 LyCORIS LoHa。只有继续旧 Lulynx 简化 LoHa 训练或加载旧权重时才选择简化实现。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要用简化实现训练准备交给第三方 LoHa 加载器直接使用的新模型。

optionDescriptions.lycoris_standard: 标准 LyCORIS LoHa，默认且推荐，与主流 LoHa 权重结构一致。
optionDescriptions.lulynx_simplified: Lulynx 历史简化实现，只用于旧训练和旧权重兼容。

standard_en.summary: Chooses the mathematical implementation of LoHa. The default is the standard LyCORIS LoHa; the Lulynx simplified LoHa is for compatibility with old training runs and old weights.
standard_en.effect: The standard implementation produces the four Hada factors the ecosystem uses; the simplified implementation keeps Lulynx's historical formula and its old export behaviour.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use the standard LyCORIS LoHa for new training. Only choose the simplified implementation to continue an old Lulynx simplified-LoHa run or to load old weights.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not train a new model with the simplified implementation if it is meant to be loaded directly by a third-party LoHa loader.

optionDescriptions.lycoris_standard: The standard LyCORIS LoHa, the default and the recommended choice, matching the mainstream LoHa weight structure.
optionDescriptions.lulynx_simplified: Lulynx's historical simplified implementation, only for old runs and old-weight compatibility.

advanced.principle: 标准实现使用 ΔW=(W1a@W1b)⊙(W2a@W2b)·(alpha/rank)。简化实现使用 ΔW=(W2a⊙W2b)^T@(W1a⊙W1b)·(alpha/rank)。
advanced.intervention: 仅在 network_module 为 LyCORIS 且 lycoris_algo=loha 时生效。
advanced.expectedImpact: 标准实现提高与 LyCORIS、ComfyUI、Musubi 等生态的 checkpoint 兼容性；简化实现保持历史结果可继续训练。
advanced.tradeoffs: 两种实现不能静默互读。Lulynx 会依据 metadata 和 tensor shape 识别并拒绝不匹配的运行时。
advanced.codePath: lycoris_loha.py → LyCORISConfig → LyCORISInjector → checkpoint identity contract

advanced_en.principle: The standard implementation uses ΔW=(W1a@W1b)⊙(W2a@W2b)·(alpha/rank). The simplified implementation uses ΔW=(W2a⊙W2b)^T@(W1a⊙W1b)·(alpha/rank).
advanced_en.intervention: Only effective when network_module is LyCORIS and lycoris_algo=loha.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: The standard implementation improves checkpoint compatibility with the LyCORIS/ComfyUI/Musubi ecosystem; the simplified keeps historical results trainable and continuing.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The two implementations must not silently read each other. Lulynx identifies and rejects mismatched runtimes via metadata and tensor shape.
advanced_en.codePath: lycoris_loha.py → LyCORISConfig → LyCORISInjector → checkpoint identity contract
